description: B2 three-reader parity probes (PR-B2 lane X): forgeries on which the RS, PY and TS retained-precision readers disagreed, or on which a manager's alignment ruling places a check, each with the gate and code every reader gives once aligned. Each shape is stated as edits from a shared corpus base in the corpus entry grammar (07n's edits and invocation_edits, rehash all by 07o's format rule) and is pinned in all three readers' tests.
bases: the shared corpus (fixtures/results/retained_precision_cases.json then retained_precision_cases_07o.json, joined), the case with the shape's base id

shapes.name: ruling 1 (g): with a combination entry, case B names case A's CaseSource
shapes.why: G3 (g)'s batch-CaseSource part binds once the receipt has a combination entry or operand_preparations: source 1 is named by no case

shapes.name: ruling 1 (g): at z = 0 the same edit keeps B1's reading
shapes.why: with no combination entry and no operand_preparations G3 adds no batch-source predicate; G5's association refuses it, as 07n's d38_m8_case_source_other

shapes.name: ruling 1 (g): at z = 0 an operand-prepared CaseSource that no record names
shapes.why: G3 (g)'s operand-prepared part applies always

shapes.name: ruling 2: a no_operands pre-source refusal requesting no operand
shapes.why: CONTRACT §2.5: requested_operands are the expression's terms whatever the Call's result

shapes.name: ruling 2: a no_operands pre-source refusal requesting the terms
shapes.why: CONTRACT §2.5: requested_operands are the expression's terms whatever the Call's result

shapes.name: ruling 3: the operand preparation names the other case's ordinary attempt
shapes.why: C3a-7 G5 with the case attempt's D4b: ordinary_attempt_ref is the owner case's ordinary attempt

shapes.name: ruling 3: the operand preparation names another material basis
shapes.why: C3a-7 G5 with the case attempt's D4b: material_basis_ref is the owner's ordinary attempt's

shapes.name: a prepared operand preparation whose CaseSource is on another material basis
shapes.why: C3a-7 G5 as a case attempt's source association: the CaseSource's material basis is the record's

shapes.name: a prepared operand preparation with an operational.new member fewer
shapes.why: C3a-7 G5: C3's preparation-stage rules, a completed preparation has every new member

shapes.name: a prepared operand preparation with a captured-prefix old inventory
shapes.why: C3a-7 G5: a prepared record has a source, so its old coverage is complete (D1)

shapes.name: a pre-source-refused combination entry names a CaseSource
shapes.why: G3 (g) names CaseSources by cases and operand preparations only; a CombinationReason cause has call_ref non-null and the rest null, a G5 products rule (CONTRACT §10.1; REVISION_01 §4.1 row 8 keeps the native class to the Call's arrays)

shapes.name: a pre-source-refused Call lists a source
shapes.why: G5 native class: pre_source_refusal has no source and no Run (REVISION_01 §4.1 row 8)

shapes.name: a case Run's origin names another case (z = 0)
shapes.why: G3 (f): each execution_order entry names the entry whose run.id is its position; the Run's own origin is G5's native class (REVISION_01 §4.1 row 9)

shapes.name: a combination Run's origin names another combination entry
shapes.why: G3 (f): each execution_order entry names the entry whose run.id is its position; the combination Run's origin is G5's native class (REVISION_01 §4.1 row 9)

shapes.name: a combination Call and its CombinationSource name an operand factor the expression does not
shapes.why: G5 native class: requested_operands are the expression's terms with their factor bits (CONTRACT §2.5), and each CombinationSource operand's factor is its term's (C2 §3); K4CMB is recomputed from the forged factors, so G8 alone would not see it

shapes.name: a pre-source-refused Call requests an operand factor the expression does not
shapes.why: G5 native class: requested_operands are the expression's terms with their factor bits (CONTRACT §2.5); with no CombinationSource, only this binding sees it

shapes.name: the gate evidence has an entry no combination entry has
shapes.why: G3 (a): one combination entry per gate-evidence entry, in the same order and with the same ids

shapes.name: a combination attempt's native stage completed while its Run is not selected
shapes.why: CONTRACT §4: native is completed iff the Run is selected; a capture error after a completed native stage is otherwise consistent (D37) and the reason table holds, so only the native-stage rule sees it

shapes.name: range operand ids in UTF-8 byte order (non-ASCII ids whose UTF-16 order differs)
shapes.why: CONTRACT §2.7 and §10.1 G8: the producer sorts range operand_ids in UTF-8 byte order (Rust String order), never UTF-16
